title: PlatformCosmoSpec
description: PlatformCosmo spec, format major version 1. Draft until v1.0.

$schema.description: Schema URL that editors use for completion, normally https://platformcosmo.io/schema/v1.json.

version.description: Spec format major version, always the string "1".

title.description: Short title of the spec, used as the SVG title element.

description.description: Longer description of the spec, used as the SVG desc element.

meta.description: Spec metadata: format version, title and description.

theme.description: Color theme for the diagram: light, dark, blueprint or mono.

grid.description: Whether to draw the iso ground grid behind the diagram (on by default; set false for a plain background).

padding.description: Empty space around the diagram in pixels, from 0 to 1000.

aspect.description: Output aspect ratio: "auto" or "width:height" such as 16:9.

canvas.description: Canvas appearance: theme, background grid, padding and aspect ratio.

nodes.description: Components to draw, each with a semantic type and an optional icon.

groups.description: Zones, VPCs, clusters or platforms that group nodes, optionally nested.

edges.description: Connections between objects (nodes, racks, equipment, or rackId/slotId).

flows.description: Animated flows of traffic or power along an edge, a cable or a pair of endpoints.

metrics.description: Headline metric tiles shown with the diagram.

steps.description: Animation steps, each with a caption, state changes, flows, metrics and a focus target.

label.description: Text shown for the legend entry.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name.

legend.description: Legend mode: "auto" to derive entries from the diagram, or a manual list of label and color pairs.

racks.description: Equipment racks, each with a height in rack units and optional slots.

equipment.description: Data-center equipment items (UPS, CRAH, CDU and similar) placed on the floor.

rows.description: Ordered rows of racks or equipment on the floor, with a facing direction.

aisles.description: Cold or hot aisles, each grouping rows of racks.

cables.description: DC cables (power, network, fiber or management) between racks, slots and equipment.

facility.description: Facility-wide settings: raised floor, perforated tiles and cable trays.

color.title: SpecColor
color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name. Flow kind names: normal, heavy, health, failed, airflow, power.

id.description: Unique identifier of the node, used by edges, flows and steps.

type.description: Semantic component type, such as lb, sql or queue.

icon.description: Icon name to draw, such as aws:rds, which must be installed.

label.description: Text label shown for the node.

badge.description: Short badge text shown on the node.

size.description: Node size: sm, md or lg.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic layout.

group.description: Id of the group that contains the node.

state.description: Initial operational state of the node: healthy, degraded, down or highlighted.

label.description: Text label shown for the group.

style.description: Visual style of the group: zone, vpc, cluster or platform.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing group, used for nesting.

id.description: Optional unique identifier of the edge, used to reference it from flows.

from.description: Source endpoint of the edge, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

to.description: Destination endpoint of the edge, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

label.description: Text label shown on the edge.

style.description: Line style of the edge: solid, dashed or dotted.

bidirectional.description: Whether the edge is drawn as two-way rather than one-way.

edge.description: Id of the edge or cable that the flow travels along.

kind.description: Flow kind that sets the default look: normal, heavy, health, failed, airflow or power.

rate.description: Particles emitted per second (0 < rate <= 20). Each flow costs ceil(rate x 2) particles; the total over base and all step flows must be <= 2000.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name.

from.description: Source endpoint of the flow, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

to.description: Destination endpoint of the flow, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

kind.description: Flow kind that sets the default look: normal, heavy, health, failed, airflow or power.

rate.description: Particles emitted per second (0 < rate <= 20). Each flow costs ceil(rate x 2) particles; the total over base and all step flows must be <= 2000.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name.

id.description: Unique identifier of the metric tile.

label.description: Text label shown on the metric tile.

value.description: Value shown on the metric tile, as text or a number.

caption.description: Text caption shown while the step plays.

set.description: State changes from this step onward (cumulative), keyed by object id or rackId/slotId.

flows.description: If present (even []), replaces the base flows for this step only; omit to keep the base flows.

metrics.description: Metric values from this step onward (cumulative), keyed by metric id.

duration.description: Step length in seconds at speed 1 (> 0, <= 600).

focus.description: Id to zoom to for this step only (object, rackId/slotId, group, row, aisle); omit for the full view.

label.description: Text label shown for the rack.

u.description: Rack height in rack units: 42, 45 or 48.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic placement.

pdu.description: PDU redundancy for the rack: none, single or dual.

rearDoorHeatExchanger.description: Whether the rack has a rear-door heat exchanger.

slots.description: Devices placed in the rack's rack units.

at.description: Lowest rack unit the device occupies (1 = bottom).

size.description: Rack units; defaults to the device type height.

type.description: Device type placed in the slot, such as server-1u or switch-tor.

label.description: Text label shown for the device in the slot.

state.description: Device state. Omit to inherit the rack state.

id.description: Unique identifier of the equipment item.

type.description: Kind of data-center equipment, such as ups, crah or cdu.

label.description: Text label shown for the equipment item.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic placement.

state.description: Operational state of the equipment item.

label.description: Text label shown for the row.

members.description: Ids of the racks or equipment items in the row, in order.

facing.description: Which side of the rack faces the row front. Omit to derive it from the aisles: rows face their cold aisle and turn their backs to their hot aisle.

label.description: Text label shown for the aisle.

kind.description: Whether the aisle is a cold aisle or a hot aisle.

rows.description: The one or two rows bounding the aisle.

contained.description: Whether the aisle is enclosed by doors or containment.

from.description: Source endpoint of the cable, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

to.description: Destination endpoint of the cable, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

kind.description: Cable type: power, network, fiber or management.

label.description: Text label shown on the cable.

endpoint.title: SpecEndpoint
endpoint.description: An object id, or rackId/slotId for a device in a rack slot.

raisedFloor.description: Whether the room has a raised floor.

perforatedTiles.description: Whether the raised floor uses perforated airflow tiles.

cableTrays.description: Where cable trays run: none, overhead or underfloor.

x.description: Horizontal grid tile coordinate, from -1000 to 1000.

y.description: Vertical grid tile coordinate, from -1000 to 1000.
